verdict.rationale: Loops ships its own official remote MCP server and installable agent skills, so a user can operate it in natural language by instructing Claude or another coding agent to manage contacts, send events and transactional email, and use the rest of the API. The natural-language layer itself is supplied by an external agent: there is no evidence of a built-in natural-language command interface inside Loops, and no hands-on corroboration that this works in practice. Missing for 10: native in-product natural-language command interface, independent or hands-on evidence of agent-driven operation, documented coverage of dashboard-only actions (e.g., sending campaigns, which are reviewed and sent from the dashboard) via natural language.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Install the CLI and skills with one command so your coding agent can use Loops for you.
Connect Claude or any remote MCP client to Loops. Your agent can manage contacts and mailing lists, send transactional email, and work with events.
With the Loops API skill, an agent can detect your stack, install an official SDK or use REST, create and update contacts, trigger events, and send transactional email.
Manage contacts and mailing lists, send transactional emails, work with events, and access the rest of the Loops API.
